title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2608.15930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation GUI agents can automate complex digital tasks, but deployment is hindered by scarce and biased training data, ambiguous prompts, and unreliable execution. Routine workflows rely on user-specific tools and tacit conventions, so unstated instructions can produce arbitrary variations across runs. We present UI-Mate, a foundation GUI agent that integrates an environment-grounded training stack with in-context demonstration learning. UI-Mate makes three contributions: A Scalable Environment-Grounded Training Stack: A closed-loop data engine automates task generation, environment construction, rollout, filtering, capability balancing, SFT, and online RL across massively parallel environments via unified task-verifier bundles. In-Context Demonstration Learning: A mechanism that transforms multimodal demonstrations into flexible subtask-level workflows, follows relevant demonstrated steps, and re-plans from the live interface. OSWorke

translated_title: UI-Mate：通过上下文演示推进开放权重基础GUI代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15930v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基础GUI代理可以自动化复杂的数字任务，但部署受到稀缺且有偏见的训练数据、模糊的提示和不可靠执行的阻碍。常规工作流依赖于用户特定的工具和隐性约定，因此未明确的指令可能在运行中产生任意变化。我们提出了UI-Mate，一个基础GUI代理，它将环境接地训练栈与上下文演示学习相结合。UI-Mate做出了三项贡献：一个可扩展的环境接地训练栈：一个闭环数据引擎通过统一的任务验证器捆绑包，在大规模并行环境中自动化任务生成、环境构建、回滚、过滤、能力平衡、SFT和在线强化学习。上下文演示学习：一种机制，将多模态演示转换为灵活的子树级工作流，遵循相关演示步骤，并从实时界面重新规划。OSWorke
tldr: UI-Mate通过环境接地训练栈和上下文演示学习，解决了基础GUI代理在数据稀缺、提示模糊和执行不可靠方面的部署难题。
en_tdlr: UI-Mate addresses deployment challenges of foundation GUI agents—scarce data, ambiguous prompts, and unreliable execution—via an environment-grounded training stack and in-context demonstration learning.
